dct_description_sm: "504963 (547149) 3-82." Shows ethnolinguistic groups: Altaic, Indo-European, Caucasian, and Hamito-Semitic families. Covers mostly Middle East, eastward, from Syria to Tibet, China/New Delhi, India, and southward, from Aral Sea area, Russia to Arabian Sea. "Proof copy." Includes legend/index to peoples. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. LC copy annotated in pencil on recto: 63. Vault
